script.title: Real footage of a rover landing on Mars
script.description: Onboard cameras captured the high-stakes descent of the Perseverance rover into Jezero Crater. This is the first time a planetary landing has been filmed from multiple perspectives.

shots.narration: This is footage of the Perseverance rover landing on Mars on 18 February 2021.
The spacecraft hits the top of the atmosphere at about 20,000 km/h during a 7-minute descent.
While the craft is still supersonic, a 21.5-metre parachute opens above.
The cameras view Jezero Crater, the site of a lake and river delta billions of years ago.
Radio signals take 11 minutes to reach Earth, meaning the landing is already over by then.
A rocket-powered descent stage hovers and lowers the rover on 7.6-metre cables before flying away.
The rover weighs about 1,025 kg, which is roughly the size of a small car.
The front of the rover and its scientific instruments rest against the Martian soil.
This was the first time a landing on another planet was filmed by the vehicle's cameras.
